latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of startup-pr-outreach skill.

- Guides startup founders and marketers through PR campaign planning for product launches, newsworthy milestones, and unconventional publicity stunts.
- Covers how to identify and bundle newsworthy angles, build the media chain, draft effective pitches, and plan amplification after media coverage.
- Includes input-gathering prompts and decision logic for milestone and target audience sufficiency.
- Features step-by-step process, using proven pitching templates, emotional angle criteria, and guidance on avoiding common pitching mistakes.
- Suitable for beginners to intermediate users aiming to land and amplify media coverage for their startup.
